text:
gabe_sales: FYI — Silverpine POC is blocked by a few enterprise asks from their CISO/legal. They want BYO-KMS with HSM attestation, SAML metadata review, and a short-term pricing guarantee for the pilot. Can we escalate?
priya_se: I'm on the SAML/KMS side. We support BYO-KMS in Private & Dedicated, but for hosted we'd need to validate HSM attestation and set up a customer keyflow. I can draft the KMS runbook and SAML sample.
gabe_sales: Their throughput ask is 2k concurrent RPS for inference, and they want deterministic latency under 200ms 95th. That's why they're pushing for Dedicated.
anita_security: Quick take: Silverpine is specifically asking for FIPS-level HSM proof. Our hosted offering doesn't have FIPS attestation. Options: 1) Offer Dedicated with BYO-HSM (customer supplies FIPS HSM) or 2) Private deploy on-prem with their HSM. Need legal + SOC2 docs to be attached.
priya_se: SAML sample (we can swap values):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Location="https://redwood.example.com/api/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
priya_se: For KMS: our BYO flow requires a signed attestation blob from HSM vendor + public key thumbprint. I'll list exact fields in the runbook.
matt_engineering: For throughput we can commit a Dedicated pool, but provisioning + infra hardening is ~10 business days if we prioritize. If legal needs a short SLA for the pilot, ops can set a 99.5% uptime target for that pool.
julia_finance: Pricing: we can do a temporary capped-commit for 3 months to unblock Procurement. Suggest: commit $50k/month with a 15% pilot discount; re-evaluate on metrics. Need expected token/embedding volumes to size.
agreed: :+1: (reaction)
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-512 — "Silverpine POC escalated: KMS/SSO/throughput". Assigned to eng-dedicated, security, and legal.
gabe_sales: Thanks — next actions I see: (1) Priya sends KMS runbook + SAML sample to Silverpine by EOD, (2) Matt confirms earliest Dedicated start date, (3) Julia drafts pilot pricing and commit terms, (4) Anita compiles required compliance docs.
amber_cto: I can take point on the exec intro to Silverpine CISO. Can we do a 30-min bridge tomorrow 10am PT? I need a 1-pager with risks and mitigations.
priya_se: I'll share the runbook and SAML sample in this thread in ~2 hours.
matt_engineering: I'll confirm infra start date by EOD and add estimated lead times for HSM onboarding.
julia_finance: I'll DM Gabe the draft pricing sheet and legal will mirror for contracts.
anita_security: I'll assemble SOC2 scope + a note on FIPS limitations. If Silverpine insists on FIPS in hosted, we escalate product/legal for an exception conversation.
gabe_sales: Great — please @mention me when docs are uploaded. If Amber can join the bridge, that should defuse CISO concerns. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
